a.lede: Petlibro's new Granary 2 smart feeders use a built-in scale and (on pricier models) an AI camera to track exactly how much your cat is eating and when — though the fanciest health-monitoring features will cost you an extra subscription.
a.title: Petlibro’s new AI-powered feeder is a game changer for multi-cat homes

b.lede: In all seriousness, this smart feeder could be quite handy for multi-cat households.
b.title: Petivity's new smart feeder asks the question 'what if Flock, but for cats?'
